# Third-party manifests
No opaque vendoring. Record name, version/commit, URL, license, and hash
for TensorFlow headers, IREE, VMA (if adopted), and Vulten (Apache-2.0,
reference only until task 001b decides) before any code is imported.
Name availability for `tf-vulkan`/`tf_vulkan` on GitHub/PyPI must be
verified before publication (spec §1/§12).
